## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — Open Questions Q1-Q5.

## Decisions required (provisional answers in #113)
- Q1: Tauri Mobile (A, default) vs PWA (B, fallback) vs RN/Flutter (C) vs native (D). Provisional A; spike to validate.
- Q2: Direct APNs+FCM (Bluesky) vs ntfy.sh (labeler) vs both with config switch. Provisional: both.
- Q3: Platform authenticator only (A) vs NFC YubiKeys (B) vs full matrix (C). Provisional A.
- Q4: Polaris-internal schedule (A) vs PagerDuty/Opsgenie (B) vs all-on-call (C). Provisional A.
- Q5: Mobile take writes through v1 case-lock; WebSocket broadcasts. Provisional: no design work needed, code-review-only.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Five decisions recorded as `--kind decision` comments.

## Blocks
- Blocks #115 (spike scope depends on Q1).
